elements.alt: Implemented light Diagnosis Comparison view for PUMP-04: earlier B1 versus Z995, measured evidence, uncertainty and next engineering check

notes.text: Retrofit Doctor connects a pump warning to its measured evidence, uncertainty and a reviewable next check or retrofit proposal. The cover is an actual screenshot of the implemented Task015 light interface, reviewed on 7 November 2026. It shows PUMP-04 at the closed minute2025-06-18 22:05–22:06 UTC: earlier B1 calibration shift on winding temperature versus Z995 flow-sensor noise. The four-case comparison includes train gains, descriptive validation and an unchanged wrong diagnosis, with explicit causal clock controls and opt-in labels. All data are synthetic; no physical device was built. Source: review/task015/01-pump04-at-alert-1440.png and docs/tasks/015-coordinator-review.md. The final user visual review remains pending; this is an implemented interface, not the UX Pilot mockup.

notes.text: The dataset contains twelve independent synthetic pumps, not six hydraulically coupled pairs. Seven are training, two are validation and three form the test split. Public equipment metadata supports coverage planning. Release disclosure: during phase-1 mutation testing, a disabled gate allowed PUMP-10 feature rows into one pytest process before approval. The implementer reports no values were printed, saved, compared or analysed; no model or parameter selection followed. The fixed causal B1 was subsequently exported under an exact manifest gate: 23 rows, schema valid, 42 prefix checks passed. This is not a pristine untouched blind evaluation. Test quality is unknown without organizer scoring. No labels or organizer predictions were used. Source: docs/tasks/007-coordinator-review.md; results/release/execution_manifest.json; assets.csv; diagrams/README.md.

notes.text: Retrospective examples from the frozen Z995 method. Train PUMP-04-E03 changes from B1 calibration shift on winding temperature to sensor noise on flow_m3_h, correctly matching simulated type and channel. Previously inspected validation PUMP-08-E02 changes from UNKNOWN to BEARING_WEAR through W1. Its first refined alert is2025-09-11T20:47Z, using snapshotPUMP-08-S023 completed17:07:23Z,13177s old, speedMATCH and6 empirical reference snapshots. BPFO envelope line is about4.8x local floor and2.6x commissioning reference. One radial snapshot is consistent with outer-race damage but does not establish a confirmed current fault. Three refined alerts belong to this one event. Train PUMP-01-E01 retains an incorrect B1 suction-pressure calibration-shift cause while simulated ground truth is strainer clogging. Missing flow prevents hydraulic cross-checking. This illustrates a capability gap, not proven installation benefit. No field confirmation. Source: results/synchronized_residual/run-20261107T093222280839Z and results/validation_z995/run-20261107T094945244932Z; docs/tasks/013-coordinator-review.md and014-coordinator-review.md.

notes.text: Train: seven assets,26 events,49asset-days. Z995 correct type8 to10, sensor type+channel3/8 to4/8, detection18/26 unchanged, false3+excess3 unchanged, class14 and nuisance2 unchanged. Wrong-specific8 to7, UNKNOWN first2 to1. Only two alert outputs change. Train selection was prospective within adaptive development on inspected synthetic data. There were23 earlier negative configurations, and four of the six Task013 configurations also failed; E995 andZ995 pass, withZ995 selected by the registered ranking. All2744 train prediction/evidence checks,30 raw aggregation checks and fresh reproduction pass. A separately sealed audit-only recovery fixed categorical future-data mutation without changing code, predictions, inputs or scores. Descriptive validation: two assets,9events,14asset-days; correct type4 to5, detected8 unchanged, class8, false1/excess0/nuisance1 unchanged, sensor type+channel2/4, wrong-specific3, wrong-channel1 unchanged. No previous correct event is lost. The changed event is PUMP-08-E02 bearing wear. All276 validation causal/evidence checks and fresh seed0 reproduction pass. There are zero applicable raw-validation checks: PUMP-08 lacks flow andPUMP-09 lacks measuredRPM. Thus the validation gain supports the waveform refinement descriptively, not independent validation of hydraulic noise attribution. Validation was already inspected, so no blind-generalization claim. Composite validation76.012539 to78.790317 is not accuracy. Original future-using B1 validation was78.012539; future reference use was removed. Sources: completed result comparison/report/run_summary files in both runs,013/014-coordinator-review.md. Seed0 and pinned environment required.

notes.text: Source: results/sensor_ablation/FINDINGS.md, train_group_summary.csv, train_paired_events.csv and manifest.json, reviewed at private Git revision 50eae57. Original 10-event denominator retained in every branch. Correct type is official first matched diagnosis, not an accuracy percentage. Burden is false episodes plus excess repeats over 21 asset-days. Mask removes channel-derived columns and working installed-channel metadata from the beginning; causal reference is recomputed. Vibration/temperature removes two detections but adds one UNKNOWN detection, net -1, and loses two correct first types. PUMP-04-E04 is detected only without this group. Flow/power mask loses PUMP-07 air-entrainment detection but improves calibration-shift first type; this is fixed-detector dependence, not a recommendation to remove instruments. Restores: 9 train + 3 descriptive PUMP-09 checks pass; causal prefix checks 414+138 pass. PUMP-09 is already inspected, descriptive only; not included in the train table. First correct-type delay does not require correct sensor channel and is not the full useful-diagnosis-delay metric.

elements.text: No hardware built. No selected supplier, fixed BOM or certification claim.

paragraphs.text: No hardware built. No selected supplier, fixed BOM or certification claim.

runs.text: No hardware built. No selected supplier, fixed BOM or certification claim.

notes.text: This is a proposal, not a built device. Reuse installed pressure, flow and VFD speed where reliable, synchronized and available at adequate cadence. Task013 used existing synthetic 1Hz telemetry; it did not demonstrate the benefit of installing new hardware. A targeted missing channel can enable a particular check, but placement, range, bandwidth, signal quality and incremental diagnostic value require site validation. A proposed read-only local gateway would timestamp and buffer measurements and run advisory analysis. Wired IO or a surveyed wireless link is an installation decision; power, routing, radio coverage/battery service, environmental enclosure and maintenance ownership remain open. Controls and operational alarms remain independent. No supplier selection, certification, physical prototype or measured ROI. Sources: docs/engineering/DECISION_BRIEF.md; SOURCES_AND_UNKNOWNS.md; docs/tasks/013-coordinator-review.md; existing sensor inventory in assets.csv. The preceding ablation uses causal B1, not the new combined method.

notes.text: Measurement hypothesis: flow, head and input power may support operating-point assessment, but flow alone does not locate an exchanger restriction or prove savings. Costs are an independent illustrative fixture, not a proposed BOM for PUMP-08. Initial 4500 EUR; annual benefit = 0.3 relevant events/year × 0.5 additional actionable fraction × 2000 EUR avoidable repair difference = 300. No production loss assumed because of hypothetical healthy standby. Nuisance =24 checks ×75 EUR=1800; upkeep=700. Annual net=−2200; 5-year value=−4500+5×−2200=−15500. With zero nuisance checks, annual net is still −400 and 5-year value −6500. No simple payback. All parameters are illustrative assumptions. Source: docs/engineering/COST_MODEL_SPEC.md and DECISION_BRIEF.md; PUMP-08 channel absence from assets.csv. Never infer field economic value from synthetic detector recall.

notes.text: Start with one maintenance decision and an accountable owner. Existing signals may be sufficient. Trial a targeted additional measurement with a reference or handheld route; do not induce damaging faults. Review actionable lead time, nuisance workload, outages and integration/service burden against existing practice. Retain a defer/no-install outcome. The proposed field architecture is read-only telemetry and optional sensors to local buffered advisory analysis; it is separate from the current replay prototype. Control, SIS and operational alarms remain independent. Site/class/flag applicability needs engineering review. No certification or customer pilot has occurred. Source: docs/engineering/DECISION_BRIEF.md and SOURCES_AND_UNKNOWNS.md.
